entries.title: Crewmates read long answers, such as a long list of checks, from a file in parts
entries.body: When something a crewmate looks up comes back longer than its model takes in at once, such as a long list of checks, pull requests or releases from GitHub or GitLab, Infinitary now keeps the whole answer in a file in the task's own folder and tells the crewmate where it is. The crewmate reads the parts it needs from there. Before, a Claude crewmate was shown only a short preview of such an answer, or had a very long one refused, and other crewmates were handed all of it at once.
entries.noPicture: The change is in what a crewmate's model is handed after a long lookup; no screen looks different.
